cohort: 160 mother-infant dyads born between July 2020 and January 2021 at a tertiary care hospital in India, born vaginally or via caesarean delivery, at or after 37 weeks gestation, and singleton births.
finding: A statistically significant improvement in LATCH scores was observed from pre-intervention (7.31+/-0.84) to post-intervention (8.9+/-0.73) after video-assisted teaching about breastfeeding.
